HOUSTON


, Oct. 12, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- Flotek Industries, Inc. ("Flotek" or the "Company") (NYSE: FTK) today announced the Company's schedule for releasing its third quarter 2026 financial and operating results.


The Company plans to issue its third quarter 2026 financial and operating results press release after market close on Tuesday, November 3, 2026, and host its earnings conference call on Wednesday, November 4, 2026, at 9:00 a.m. CT (10:00 a.m. ET). The press release will be posted on the Company's website at[https://ir.flotekind.com/press-releases](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4795879-1&h=1634381683&u=https%3A%2F%2Fir.flotekind.com%2Fpress-releases&a=https%3A%2F%2Fir.flotekind.com%2Fpress-releases) .


Participants may access the call through Flotek's website at[https://ir.flotekind.com/events](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4795879-1&h=1711554075&u=https%3A%2F%2Fir.flotekind.com%2Fevents&a=https%3A%2F%2Fir.flotekind.com%2Fevents) , by telephone toll free at 1-800-836-8184 (international toll: 1-646-357-8785), or by using the following link to access the webcast:[https://app.webinar.net/KaD61d81pgX](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4795879-1&h=572889022&u=https%3A%2F%2Fapp.webinar.net%2FKaD61d81pgX&a=https%3A%2F%2Fapp.webinar.net%2FKaD61d81pgX) approximately five minutes prior to the start of the call. Following the conclusion of the conference call, a recording of the call will be available on the Company's website.


**About Flotek Industries, Inc.**


Flotek Industries, Inc. is a global technology-driven company that combines the synergy of proprietary technologies through near real-time data analytics and advanced chemistry to collaboratively address complex challenges for energy, industrial and infrastructure sector customers and help them optimize operations, enhance asset performance and maximize financial returns.


Leveraging a portfolio of more than 130 patents, over two decades of field and laboratory data, and a global presence in more than 59 countries, Flotek delivers innovative, data-driven solutions designed to create measurable value across the energy and infrastructure lifecycle.


Flotek is based in Houston, Texas and its common shares are traded on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol "FTK." For additional information, please visit[www.flotekind.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4795879-1&h=4158787835&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.flotekind.com%2F&a=www.flotekind.com) .
